Class CasteTemplate

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.CasteTemplate
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CasteTemplate extends Object implements Serializable
Data-driven template for defining custom ant castes. Replaces hardcoded enums for greater flexibility.
